label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_sp01_00
text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)]! Welcome back![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_sp01_01
text: How was that trip you took with Kieran and the\nothers?[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_sp01_select_01
text: It was a piece of cake!

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_sp01_select_02
text: It was such a headache!

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_sp01_02
text: I bet the group had everything wrapped up neat\nas a bow in no time, with you there![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_sp01_02b
text: Oh, I’m sure it was! Thank you for all the help\nyou must have provided.[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_sp01_03
text: You were investigating that huge crater in the\nPaldea region, weren’t you?[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_sp01_04
text: To think, you came here to study abroad...and\nthen we sent you right back to Paldea!\c\nThat wasn’t very well done, was it?[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_sp01_select_03
text: It was fine!

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_sp01_select_04
text: I guess not...

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_sp01_05
text: Oh, you’re so understanding... If it were me, I\nwould’ve been grumbling the whole time![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_sp01_05b
text: Right! I knew you’d agree! That sort of thing...\nIt’s just not right![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_sp01_06
text: Sometimes this school is a bit too permissive\nabout things...[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_sp01_07
text: Which is why we all have a duty to say loud and\nclear when we think something isn’t right![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_sp02_00
text: Oh! Do you happen to have a little time to spare,\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]?[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_sp02_01
text: I wanted to catch you up on the League Club\nlatest. You missed a little while you were away.[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_sp02_02
text: For one thing, we decided to put a temporary\nhalt to any rank changes in the BB League!\r\nHopefully, that’ll help prevent more confusion.[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_sp02_03
text: We also officially wrote into the rules that even\nvisiting students can be Champion![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_sp02_04
text: And we reviewed all the club rules that Kieran\nhad changed to make too strict. We’ve rolled\r\nthem back to what they used to be.[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_sp02_05
text: Plus some other little odds and ends! My, we\nput ourselves up to a lot, didn’t we?[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_sp02_select_01
text: Thanks for the hard work!

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_sp02_select_02
text: You certainly did!

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_sp02_06
text: Oh! Sorry, no—I wasn’t fishing for compliments or\nanything![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_sp02_07
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Forget I said anything,
[VAR 0x0100(0000)]!
We
were
just
doing
our
job![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_sp02_08
text: Though not that Drayton, of course. He was\nsleeping through the whole meeting. Sleeping!\r\nCan you believe that?![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_sp02_09
text: Anyway! That’s all I had to report! You are now\nall caught up on the recent club happenings![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_sp03_00
text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Do you have time for a quick chat,\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]?[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_sp03_01
text: You see, things got quite strained in the club\nwhile Kieran was Champion...[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_sp03_02
text: We had quite a few people quit because it\nsimply stopped being fun for them.[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_sp03_03
text: Which is why I’d like you to decide on a new\ndirection for the club, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_sp03_04
text: What do you think we should focus on?[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_sp03_select_01
text: Having fun and working hard!

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_sp03_select_02
text: Enjoying ourselves together!

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_sp03_select_03
text: I guess I’d say...“safety first”!

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_sp03_05
text: Having fun and working hard... Yes, I think that\nwould be a fine idea![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_sp03_05b
text: Enjoying ourselves together... Yes, I think that\nwould be a fine idea![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_sp03_05c
text: Safety first...? Hmm, it makes me think we’re\ngoing to work at a construction site or something.\r\nBut I suppose it IS important to stay safe![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_sp03_06
text: With this, we’ll be able to make the club a lovely\nplace for everyone again. Thank you so much![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_trade_01_00
text: I think we’ve taken care of all the lingering tasks\nI had for the club![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_trade_01_01
text: Phew, I’m plumb tuckered out... I think I need to\nsoothe these tired feelings away by sharing\r\nsome cuteness...[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_trade_03_01

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_trade_04_00

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_talkto_00

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_cancel_00

Battles here at Blueberry Academy!\c
You’ve got to have at least two Pokémon with

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_battleend_win_00_00
text: You’re as strong as ever! And oh so cute![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_battleend_win_00_01
text: You’ve given me so many adorable memories to\ncherish that I want to give you something back...[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_battleend_win_00_02
text: How about one of the smartphone cases we\nmade in the League Club?[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_battleend_win_00_03
text: Feel free to put it on your phone, if you like![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_reward_00
text: You received a [VAR 0xFF00(0008)]Blueberry Case (White) [VAR 0xFF00(0000)]from\nLacey!

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_battleend_win_01_00
text: That was a great battle! Here, I feel like you\ndeserve something for your efforts![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: coach_bb4kings_fairy_battleend_win_01_01

still a battle bursting with cuteness!\c

applause for their efforts![VAR 0x0114(0049)]
